name: Sundargarh Sadar
description: Tribal-dominated block with paddy as primary crop; rainfed agriculture; prone to mid-season dry spells.

name: Bonai Block
description: Forest-fringe block with highest agrarian distress; irregular monsoon onset, heavy informal debt burden.

name: Rajgangpur Block
description: Mixed-cropping zone with some canal irrigation; relatively more resilient but faces market price volatility.
